limitations: The first page test used explicit module bootstrap while the page did not exist. The final test navigates the normal launch page.
Early setup runs hit a browser navigation timeout and a scrollbar-only pixel difference. Neither is counted as proof of the missing product behavior.

The first reset-race clock probe matched explicit zero-delay timers only and passed before the fix. It was corrected to include omitted-delay timers; only the subsequent 16-versus-0 failure counts as the regression's red checkpoint.
